Code-switching refers to the alternation between two or more languages within a single utterance or discourse.

Below are ten examples of naturally occurring Mandarin–English code-switching:

<examples>
bus直接开进小区里面。
若有人担心厕所要share，其实这并不是问题！
地址：near frick park
房间很大，每个人独立的bedroom和bathroom，utility基本全包，furnished，免费停车。
富有责任心现在就申请请发送你的resume至em@111
所以在那天才能pick up.
有意帮付$450 security deposit
最好是couple，稳定一点的那种。
可share油费等。
之前看到有贴大家说state id就可以是penn state id吗？
</examples>

Generate ten new Mandarin–English code-switched sentences in a range of linguistic styles, registers, and code-switching patterns. Each sentence should contain both Mandarin and English. Do not copy or closely paraphrase the examples. Return only a JSON array of ten strings, without explanations, translations, or annotations.
